stones.label: City of the Thousand Wells
stones.causal_role: Vertical boreholes sunk through limestone strata multiply into an intricate upward skyline wherever the subterranean lake lies beneath.

stones.label: Deep Subterranean Black Lake & Feeder Streams
stones.causal_role: Enclosed pocket of dark water fed by underground streams; its lapping wave physics supply all upward hydraulic momentum.

stones.label: Calcareous Rock Sky
stones.causal_role: Vaulted limestone cavern ceiling enclosing the black lake; probes must pierce this rock vault inside its contour to draw living water.

stones.label: Green Border Repeating the Buried Lake's Dark Outline
stones.causal_role: Surface botanical margin thrives strictly across xNorm in [0.17, 0.83], visibly repeating the invisible subterranean contour while outer flanks remain bleached dry limestone.

stones.label: First Religion: Gods of the Depths
stones.causal_role: Theological lens privileging the abyssal black lake and underground feeder streams as the living divine origin while rendering upper scaffolding as ghostly capillary extensions.

stones.label: Suspended Buckets Rising Over Well-Edges
stones.causal_role: Gods-of-ascent locus: cable-hung buckets emerging above limestone well-curbs driven by subterranean wave pressure.

stones.label: Revolving Pulleys & Noria Windlasses
stones.causal_role: Gods-of-ascent locus: rotating sheaves and endless cup-chain windlasses lifting dark water into sunlight.

stones.label: Pump Handles, Windmill Blades & Twisting Probe Trestles
stones.causal_role: Gods-of-ascent locus: reciprocating pump levers, wind-driven extraction vanes, and helical rotary drilling derricks.

stones.label: Stilted Roof Reservoirs & Slender Aqueduct Arches
stones.causal_role: Gods-of-ascent locus: elevated cisterns perched on thin stilts above roofs linked horizontally by delicate aqueduct spans across adjacent wells.

stones.label: Water Columns, Vertical Pipes, Plungers, Drains & Airy Weathercocks
stones.causal_role: Gods-of-ascent zenith: surging vertical water columns and reciprocating plungers culminating in spinning weathercocks crowning an entirely upward-moving filigree city.

calvino_source.inner_arch: An invisible sunken landscape conditions every boundary and motion of a visible filigree city moving entirely upward—splitting theology between abyssal origin in the subterranean black lake and kinetic vertical apparatus in the sunlit sky.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Tall vertical geological-hydraulic cross-section, rotary borehole drilling rig, shallow-water cavern wave solver, dual-religion theological lens instrument, plus Royal Plate Guild hand-colored copperplate cartography (map.png / map.svg) and fine-art architectural plate (image.png).
anti_trude_vector.typography: Self-contained system engraved transitional serif ('Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Georgia, serif) paired with tabular technical monospace ('SF Mono', 'Menlo', monospace); zero external font CDNs.

contour_law.rule: Vertical shafts drilled with xNorm in [0.17, 0.83] pierce the calcareous rock sky into the buried black lake (hitLake=true), coupling wave hydraulics skyward and aligning with the surface green border. Vertical shafts drilled outside [0.17, 0.83] hit dry calcareous bedrock (hitLake=false), emit dry chalk dust, draw zero water, and raise only a motionless dry probe stub.

interface_contract.depth_coordinate: depthFrac in [0, 1] measures downward distance from viewport.surfaceY (0.0) to viewport.height (1.0).

isaura-karst-depths.epistemic_partition: Models the subterranean calcareous rock sky, underground feeder streams, 1D shallow-water lapping black wave physics, planimetric buried contour, and surface green border; blind to upward_apparatus internals.

isaura-sky-scaffolder.epistemic_partition: Models all upward sunlit filigree machinery (suspended buckets, revolving pulleys, noria windlasses, pump handles, windmill blades, twisting probe trestles, stilted roof reservoirs, slender aqueduct arches, water columns/plungers/drains, airy weathercocks, and dry limestone bore stubs); blind to buried_black_lake internals.

isaura-weaver.epistemic_partition: Bundles layers inline into a 100% standalone zero-external-dependency index.html with custom <isaura-*> DOM, WebAudio, keyboard + reduced-motion support, responsive 1280x800 / 390x844 layouts, and an inspectable Map & City Plate drawer displaying local map.png and image.png.

isaura-critic.epistemic_partition: Performs title-masked blind recognition and deterministic verification of HG-1..HG-5 before issuing PASS with rev_hash to @scion-isaura.

hard_gates.HG-1: 100% standalone index.html: zero external http/https script/link/font/image URLs, zero ../ cross-city imports, bespoke <isaura-*> tag-paths and .isaura-* CSS selectors ensuring J_dom < 0.35.
hard_gates.HG-2: Strict causal boundary-contour drilling law: drilling inside [0.17, 0.83] pierces the calcareous rock sky into the lapping black lake, matches the green surface border, and drives upward water columns; drilling outside [<0.17 or >0.83] hits dry calcareous limestone with zero water ascent.
hard_gates.HG-3: Dual-religion theological schism & canonical completeness: all 10 Calvino stone groups actively participate and transform across 'depths', 'ascent', and 'schism' lenses.
hard_gates.HG-4: Clean layout & runtime at 1280x800 and 390x844, zero console/runtime errors, full keyboard accessibility, and prefers-reduced-motion compliance.
hard_gates.HG-5: Valid Royal Plate Guild archival plates map.svg, map.png (>=1200px wide PNG, high pixel/color variance), and image.png (>=1200px wide PNG, rich pixel/color variance) present in cities/10_isaura/ and inspectable via a Map & City Plate drawer/tab (referencing map.png and image.png) inside index.html.
